forms.plain_english: Quarterly snapshot of long US-listed equity positions (13(f) securities) of any institutional investment manager with at least $100M in such securities. The information table lists issuer, class, CUSIP, value, shares, discretion, other managers. Berkshire's table is split per sub-manager combination (Buffett, National Indemnity, GEICO...), so the same issuer appears on many rows and must be summed.
forms.who_files_when: Managers file within 45 days of quarter end (Berkshire: 2026-08-14 for 6/30/2026, 2026-05-15, 2026-02-17, 2025-11-14). Confirmed in Atom feed. 13F-HR/A used to amend or to release previously confidential holdings. Apple/Microsoft/Netflix do not file; Alphabet and Amazon DO file 13F-HR as managers of their own venture/strategic equity portfolios (Atom feeds verified, quarterly).

companies.frequency: not checked (N-PX feed empty; no 13F expected)

machine_readable.format: XML: primary_doc.xml (cover/summary, schema X0202) plus information table XML (file name varies per filer: 56757.xml, infotable.xml, information_table.xml). No XBRL. Filenames are not fixed, so discover them via the folder index.
structured_fields: nameOfIssuer, titleOfClass, cusip, value, sshPrnamt, sshPrnamtType, putCall, investmentDiscretion, otherManager, voting authority

financial_intelligence.detail: Data quality: Q1 2026 name strings differ from Q2 (BANK AMERICA CORP vs BANK OF AMER CORP; NEW YORK TIMES CO vs NEW YORK TIMES CO MTN BE; Capital One appears as 'COF' in Q2). A product must key on CUSIP and pre-aggregate sub-manager rows, and map CUSIP to CIK for joins.

13F cannot show shorts, non-US, or non-13(f) securities; no put/call rows exist in Berkshire's table. Values are reported in whole dollars in these filings (since 2023 rule; the raw XML does not state the unit).

forms.plain_english: Annual report of proxy votes. Funds file full records; since the 2023 rule (first reports 2024) institutional managers must report say-on-pay (Section 14A) votes on N-PX. Alphabet and Amazon appear because they are themselves institutional managers (they file 13F-HR) holding public equities, not because of employee plans.
forms.who_files_when: Annually by August 31 for the year ended June 30. Alphabet filed 2026-08-28, 2025-08-29, 2024-09-03; Amazon 2026-08-06, 2025-08-27, 2024-08-23. Berkshire, Apple, Microsoft, Netflix: empty Atom feeds (Berkshire has no N-PX).

structured_fields: reportType (INSTITUTIONAL MANAGER VOTING REPORT / NOTICE REPORT)
per vote: issuer, CUSIP, meeting date, matter, shares voted, shares on loan, how voted, management recommendation
